> **Default**(`defaultValue`): `PropertyDecorator`

Defined in: [packages/env/src/decorators/default.decorator.ts:15](https://github.com/NanoForge-dev/Engine/blob/ed8c7e0b33d17f8343c32659cf63ba4166a4fa53/packages/env/src/decorators/default.decorator.ts#L15)

Property decorator that supplies a fallback value when the environment
variable is `undefined` or `null`.

## Parameters

### defaultValue

`unknown`

The value to use when the property is absent.

## Returns

`PropertyDecorator`

## Remarks

Pairs with `class-transformer`'s `@Expose` and `class-validator`
decorators. The default is deep-cloned via `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(…))`
so objects are not shared between instances.
